set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 2. Starting from the Phase-0-frozen contracts, introduce pure ArchiveRevision and publication state, resource-backed OpenArchive[F], typed PayloadExecutor, structural versus content validation, and receipt evidence over current eager LNA-HDF5 and Zarr paths. This slice runs in parallel with RRA 1 and does not depend on its implementation; the Track-A epic gate owns final adaptation to the response-facing axis-keyed capability and receipt types. Acceptance: valid unknown representations remain inspectable; incomplete publication differs from unsupported representation; eager HDF5 reports WholePayload for the relevant axes; Zarr retains exact object/range/byte evidence; mixed time/sample claims conform after integration; success, failure, and cancellation close resources; the frozen numerical regression corpus remains green on JVM and Scala.js.
